paths.path: Keyboard plus Allegro joysticks, selected by CLI stick attributes
paths.naming: Two sticks default to joystick 0 with schemes 0/1 via set_defjoykeys; F-key UI actions live in keyboard.c.

paths.path: highscore.txt in the working directory (-scorefile= overrides)
paths.naming: Single integer high score written on change; empty default score writes 0.
F-key save/load through keyboard.c into the configured statefile; missing file means no save yet.
BIOS identity probed by identify_bios; launcher paths with backslashes normalize separators.
